overview: ThinkBig is a two-sided idea marketplace where idea sellers publish business, agriculture, medicine, engineering and other ideas, and idea buyers browse, filter and contact sellers to invest.
features: Sign in and choose an Idea Seller or Idea Buyer account
Sellers publish ideas with a field, business plan, funding target and documents
Buyers browse and filter ideas by field, stage and funding range
Buyers express interest and contact sellers directly
Seller dashboard with interest counts and interested buyers
